name: Chat apps
description: Connect your existing WhatsApp account and link your private groups to individual Claude or Codex agents. Experimental linked-device connection; no second phone number. Set up in Configure. Computer must stay awake with CliDeck running.

commands.name: whatsapp
commands.description: Set up WhatsApp and link groups to agents. status, connect, disconnect, groups, bind <group-id> [session-id], unbind <group-id>, test <group-id>, pending, acknowledge <request-id>. Pairing QR is only shown in Configure.
